title: Single implementation plan - evidence-backed skill optimization
summary: Implement the 32 prepared topic decisions and the opt-in provider-switch track in one validated graph. Research is supplied; tests, corrections and independent code review remain pending. No second plan is created.

request_parts.text: Implement the prepared research recommendations in this one plan; do not create another plan.
Use the pinned source inventory and per-feature reports to implement traceable skill improvements.
Replace every research task and its internal checklist with implementation instructions linked to its prepared report.
Require independent maximum-available-capability code review after each implementation topic; do not fabricate reviewer execution.
Compare quality per validated cost, alternatives, risks and measurable regression criteria.
Implement the opt-in provider-top switching improvement within this single plan.
Reconfirm decisive source claims; distinguish verified facts, hypotheses and new inference.
Modify only the source checkout; preserve installed skills and user-global configuration.
Pin the actual source baseline, affected tests and historical evidence; do not represent old logs as fresh validation.
Continue in the existing checkpoint workstream without modifying main or publishing without permission.
Require confirmation before commit, push, PR, npm publication and authenticated provider execution.
Keep the new provider-switch behavior opt-in; disabled behavior and argv goldens stay unchanged.
Use one explicit provider-chain policy so the ladder matches the actual dispatched provider.
Derive useful top from resolved model and effective effort, including embedded slugs and snapshot/profile rules.
Make every eligible provider reachable within documented attempt budgeting; test third-provider access at budget eight.
Define mechanical/budget retry exceptions; environmental, plan_defect and timeout_ceiling never trigger capability switching.
Use the prepared comparison to implement deterministic handoff first; keep additional paid summary calls and native retention out of the default.
Redact secrets before truncation and bound the handoff; never capture environment or profile values.
Label handoff as unverified data after deterministic evidence; it cannot change route, class or status.
Validate handoff paths against diff, commands against evidence and subtask IDs against the manifest.
Produce deterministic handoff when the previous provider is unavailable or its report is missing or invalid.
Keep byte-stable prompt prefixes, add only the newest attempt-bound capsule and retain failure_context.
Preserve strict report-schema compatibility, including Codex required-nullable fields and Antigravity null adaptation.
Preserve manifest schemas 1-4, missing failure_classes, version-1 configuration snapshots and availability ledger compatibility.
Keep availability separate from functional evidence; preserve provider, quota_pool and model cooldowns and exit 75.
Honor fallback-disabled and existing provider override semantics; never widen a forbidden chain.
Define and test design-phase switching, shared counters, reset and resumability.
Validate new configuration subkeys, defaults, global/plan layers and routing fingerprints.
Record provider-switch and handoff cost telemetry without secrets; preserve rollup and benchmark contracts.
Resolve snapshot models and workload native effort before deciding whether a rung changes actual dispatch.
Fix or explicitly justify deferral of empty-tier dispatch and the omitted failure evidence-packet path.
Verify CLI capabilities from official docs and installed non-generative discovery; record divergences.
Keep English docs and Portuguese mirrors synchronized; respect entrypoint budgets and required phrases.
Reproduce all twelve acceptance cases and run affected self-tests plus npm ci, npm run check and npm pack --dry-run.
Reconcile the resource map without losing reusable inventory; report pre-existing validation failures separately.
Make final whole-skill maintenance and implementation acceptance the last task.
Consume the prepared reports with numbered sources, URL/access date and explicit evidence-versus-inference labels.
Use the completed provider, literature and public book-excerpt research; refresh only a material version-sensitive gap.
Keep each worker context task-local; share concise evidence instead of conversation transcripts.
Do not install into user copies or change the user-global routing config.
Keep prepared research outside disposable control state so all implementation tasks retain their source evidence.
Do not mark research, highest-model review or product implementation complete without actual evidence.
Replace former second-plan tasks with integration, regression, packaging and final acceptance of this single implementation.
Record a newly discovered material gap with provenance and a bounded contract amendment; do not restart broad research by default.
Report decisions, changed files, actual validation, unverified platforms and risks in Brazilian Portuguese.

repository_findings: The production runner composes raw execution with artifact, model, runner and pattern contracts.
Declared-chain escalation and escalated-tier availability can select different providers in the baseline.
All 32 research topics now have prepared reports; all implementation and independent review tasks remain pending.

request_analysis.research_decision: Broad research is prepared in 32 linked reports; implementation consumes it and refreshes only material invalidated evidence.
research_findings: Context selection, compact summaries and retrieval are engineering choices; more accumulated material is not automatically better.
Durable progress artifacts, incremental changes and explicit tests support work that crosses context windows.
Learned routing uses workload evidence; preference labels and software acceptance are different targets.
The CLI documents model discovery, conversation controls and model-dependent effort. A listed effort value is not proof every model accepts it.
Current documentation makes --prompt non-interactive and rejects combining it with --yolo, --auto or --plan. Adapter selection must be version-aware.
Logs should exclude or protect secrets, sanitize untrusted data, restrict access and follow an explicit retention policy.
The files allowlist and ignore rules determine tarball membership; some entries have special inclusion rules.
Sessions persist conversation history, not filesystem state; replay/resume and source changes must be handled independently.
assumptions: The latest user request supersedes only the two-plan and future-research workflow, not compatibility, safety or honest acceptance.
The existing checkpoint branch remains the workstream; no new publication is performed.
risks: No authenticated CLI or independent external reviewer was exercised during research.
Current documentation can differ from installed versions; capability fixtures and bounded probes must reconcile a material mismatch.
Offline route replay is not a measurement of real model quality, quota consumption or dollar savings.
Prepared source hashes are baseline evidence; implementation deliberately changes them and must record the new validated state.
open_questions: Authenticated execution and independent maximum-qualified review require an available authorized provider at implementation time.
request_analysis.decomposition_strategy: Keep stable IDs; implement each prepared topic, then independently review and correct it. Serialize overlapping write scopes. Integrate and validate all changes in this single plan.
